4364-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Move to your next turn. Optionally, you can instead give Massimo haste.
Declare Massimo and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
4364-5895-8330.notes: You can also do this combo in one turn if you give the ability to a creature that has haste (excluding Aurelia) instead. If you give the ability to another creature, you will need to cause that creature to enter, target the creature with Massimo, and then replace Massimo in the combat phase with the creature. If you do this in one turn, either with Massimo or another creature, ensure that Aurelia has not attacked during that turn.

1818-1981-2415-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

567-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2757-3525-8039.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Spireside Infiltrator
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

2111-4981-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-1843-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-1843-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-2079-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

985-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1402-2511-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1753-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2866-2921-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

3368-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Reiterate
3368-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying the original Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.

1793-5231-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1793-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1247-5536-5833.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more creatures.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Leafkin Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5833.description:
Activate Rex using Leafkin Druid's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3519-3875-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3519-3875-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate each Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} for each token.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling the Forest Dryads, and you may create infinite Food or Treasure tokens using Tireless Provisioner.

575-2482-2860.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting the creature card into your hand.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

813-4276-4615.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
813-4276-4615.description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Turnabout and Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2914-4228-4992.notablePrerequisites: Bear Umbra attached to Stormtide Leviathan.
2914-4228-4992.description:
Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping.
Bear Umbra can untap your lands.

3096-4400.notablePrerequisites:
Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have no basic lands in library.
3096-4400.description:
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, reveal cards from the top of your library and then putting them into your graveyard.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two and drawing you a card.
Jace triggers, winning you the game.
